report.summary: daedalus/eval/correctness.py: Implements a correctness evaluator using FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS test sets, with before-state verification via disposable worktrees and git/base revision management, producing five outcomes: fixed, not_fixed, regressed, could_not_run, task_invalid.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/eval/correctness.py|A base revision is only ever checked out through GitWorktreeManager, which places worktrees outside the checkout.
CLAIMS|daedalus/eval/correctness.py|The outcome regressed outranks not_fixed, and both outrank fixed; could_not_run outranks all three.
